beats.text: This railway bridge is taller than the Eiffel Tower.
It spans a deep gorge with no road at the bottom.
It's earthquake country, with strong winds.
So builders cut roads, then hung a cable crane across.
The steel arch grew outward from both sides, held back by cables.
They met in the middle, four hundred sixty-seven meters across.
Piers on the arch carry the track deck.
Designed for two hundred sixty-six kilometer an hour winds and the top earthquake zone.
Trains began crossing in June twenty twenty-five.
